title: Export every PcbLib footprint to a STEP file
summary: Writes the 3D model of each footprint of a PCB library to its own .step file, through a transient IPCB_Component loaded with LoadFromLibrary or directly from IPCB_LibComponent.SaveModelToFile, and reports which files were written.
phrasings: save each footprint's 3D model as a step file
batch export a PCB library to STEP
load a footprint into a temporary component
write 3D models of library footprints to disk

commands.name: GenerateStep
commands.description: Export every footprint of a PcbLib to STEP files
commands.params: Lib=<.PcbLib path> (default: the focused PCB library)|Out=<folder> (default: temp folder; files go to <Out>\<library name>\<footprint>.step)|Via=Component|LibComponent (default Component: a transient IPCB_Component)|Attach=false (Via=Component only: do not assign the library's board to the transient component; LoadFromLibrary then raises an access violation)
